prompt: This code intends to filter even numbers but always returns an empty list. Why?
choices: filter() removes elements matching the predicate
The predicate n % 2 == 1 keeps odd numbers, not even ones — use n % 2 == 0
stream() is not available on List.of()
explanation: n % 2 == 1 is true for odd numbers. To keep evens, the predicate should be n % 2 == 0. filter() keeps elements for which the predicate returns true. This is a logic error, not a Java error — the code compiles and runs but produces the wrong result.
